objective: Allow a task explicitly assigned to the existing licon branch to pass scope validation without weakening the default requirement-branch policy or any other admission gate.

requirements.statement: Formal governance must document licon as the sole existing-branch exception while retaining the default requirement-branch format.
acceptance: The formal rule and summaries state both the default format and the exact licon exception.
counterexample: A script-only exception or an exception that permits other branch names.

requirements.statement: Scope validation must accept an assignment.branch value exactly equal to licon.
acceptance: The current ready REQ-20260917-082 scope passes the validator while checked out on licon.
counterexample: Rejecting licon or requiring an additional branch prefix.

requirements.statement: Scope validation must continue to reject main, an empty branch, case variants, and arbitrary nonconforming branch names.
acceptance: Node regression tests reject main, empty string, Licon, and custom-branch.
counterexample: Accepting any branch other than main.

requirements.statement: Branch acceptance must not bypass ready-requirement, owner, writable-path, or other existing task-admission checks.
acceptance: The valid current scope still undergoes the existing validator and governance checks pass.
counterexample: Returning success immediately after the branch condition matches.

invariants: licon is an exact lowercase single exception.
main, PR, approval, Required Checks, and branch-protection rules are unchanged.
constraints: GITHUB-RULES.md remains the formal policy source.
Only REQ-20260917-082 writable paths may change.
No business code, database, API, or external-access change is permitted.

assumptions.text: The Node scope validator is the local and CI enforcement point for assignment.branch.
assumptions.basis: The current script rejects the current licon assignment at its branch regex.
assumptions.falsifier: A separate enforced validator applies a divergent branch rule.

decisions.question: Which existing branch may be exempted?

measurement_intents.observable: Synchronized formal and summary policy wording
Only licon and compliant requirement branches are accepted
Existing governance and scope validation completes without bypass

evidence: User approved the design and implementation plan in this conversation; the current validator rejects licon before implementation.
